help.title: About Dashboard
help.overview: Operational view of one edifice. The gallery chooses the building; units, collections, rent, and alerts follow that choice. With no edifice selected, the figures are the whole company.

sections.title: Layout
items: Edifice gallery at the top — select a building to focus every KPI and the units list below.
KPI row: total units, sold, collected, average price per m², plus rent collected / outstanding / overdue and active leases when rental records exist.
Period control (last 7 days, 30 days, 3 months, 12 months) changes collected/revenue windows, not the unit inventory itself.
Charts show unit-status mix and revenue over the selected period.
The units table/cards below are the same Units resource, already scoped to the selected edifice.
Payment alerts deep-link into payment plans / reservations that need attention.

sections.title: How figures are produced
items: Total / sold / reserved / rented are counts of units in that edifice by commercial status.
Collected comes from sale receipts and payment-plan activity in the period — not from typing a target.
Average €/m² uses unit prices and areas on those units; it does not reprice anything.
Rent collected / outstanding / overdue sums rental payment rows on leases for units in this edifice.
Active leases counts leases that are still active on those units.

sections.title: What this page will not do
items: It will not change unit status. Reserve, sell, or lease from those lists.
Selecting another edifice does not change the project — each edifice already belongs to a project.
Portfolio is the company-wide cut of these figures. Group dashboard rolls up several companies.

sections.title: Related records
items: Use “View payment plans” / “View rentals hub” when those alerts appear.
